title: Sheneset: A Digital TEI Edition of the Nag Hammadi Codices
description:
A TEI P5 corpus and website for the Coptic texts of the Nag Hammadi Codices (NHC I–XIII): morpheme-level annotation (lemma and part of speech), a Coptic lexicon with Japanese, English and French senses, Japanese, English and French translations, parallel passages, and the full text of the codices as working files (39 tractates with a draft automatic annotation that has not been checked by hand).

The Coptic texts and the Greek text of Plato's Republic (OCT/Burnet) are in the public domain. The data and texts created by the project (TEI encoding, translations, glosses, lexicon, list of parallels, essays) are released under CC BY 4.0. The source code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Python scripts) is released under the MIT License (see LICENSE).

Website: https://sheneset.vercel.app/
